name: Summit AZ - Sewer Line Repair City Pages
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-10-03

# Summary
Rewrite drafts for three sewer line repair city pages: Mesa (Sep 26, low-hanging-fruit plan) and Fountain Hills plus Queen Creek (Oct 3, striking-distance batch). All three were applied live (Mesa Sep 26 per the handoff; Fountain Hills and Queen Creek Oct 3 per the change log). The earlier Sep 3 batch report for the sewer family is in [Summit AZ - Sewer Batch 1 Report 2026-09-03](lib:brain-summit-az-sewer-batch-1-report-2026-09-03).

# Pages
| City | ID | Draft file | Why | Keywords |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mesa | 10231 | `Summit-AZ-Sewer-Line-Repair-Mesa-Draft-2026-09-26.md` | Slipped to position 19 to 21; about 60% similar to siblings, so a strengthening rewrite | sewer line repair (14,800, KD 56 exception), sewer line replacement (4,400 / 29) |
| Fountain Hills | 10229 | `Summit-AZ-Sewer-Line-Repair-Fountain-Hills-Draft-2026-10-03.md` | Position 9 to 10, 0 clicks; 63% same as Apache Junction | sewer line repair Fountain Hills, trenchless sewer repair (4,400 / 15), sewer line replacement, sewer line inspection (3,600 / 5), main sewer line repair |
| Queen Creek | 10233 | `Summit-AZ-Sewer-Line-Repair-Queen-Creek-Draft-2026-10-03.md` | Position 8 to 13 on five searches; 44% same as Tempe | sewer line repair Queen Creek, trenchless sewer repair, sewer line replacement, sewer camera inspection (8,100 / 18) |

# Key decisions
- Mesa: "trenchless" removed from all rewritten text (it appeared 16 times) so the page does not compete with the Mesa trenchless blog; Orangeburg mentioned once as a link. Sourced City of Mesa facts (street-or-alley repair rule, camera recording guidance, the 1950s clay main on Broadway Road). Title debate: full repair-and-replacement wording does not fit with the brand suffix.
- Fountain Hills and Queen Creek: removed pipe bursting (unconfirmed), "Customer Satisfaction Guarantee", "35+ years", same-day box, unsourced home-age and tree-root claims, and unconfirmed neighborhoods (Encanterra, Ironwood Crossing, Queen Creek Station).
- "emergency sewer repair" searches not targeted until Scott decides on emergency strategy.

# Results so far
- Early check Oct 5: /sewer-line-repair-mesa/ impressions per day 5.7 to 12.8 (+124% vs site -10%); new broad terms "sewer line repair" position 9.2 and "sewer line replacement" 8.0.
- Oct 3 rewrites were indexed; Request Indexing for Fountain Hills hit the daily quota twice.
